attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as authoritative DNS for app.internal -> node2's IP via dnsmasq UCI (dhcp @domain section), and pointed node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) at node1 for DNS by editing the cloud-init-generated systemd-networkd file plus a resolvconf head override (to work around a lease-vs-state duplicate-DNS quirk in the OS's resolvconf-update helper). Stood up a minimal persistent HTTP service on node2 port 8080 (systemd unit, since none existed). Verified name resolution and HTTP reachability from node3 to node2 by name with no /etc/hosts entry. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart functional verification.
